pages.title: INSTRUMENT SPECIFICATION
notes: TBA: To be Assigned.
*: Vendor to Assign.
IBR Certification is applicable for Desuperheater & Temperature Control Valve.

Following tests required: - MATERIAL TEST CERTIFICATE FOR TRIM AND BODY AS PER EN 3.1, - IGC-E FOR TRIM, - RADIOGRAPHY FOR CASTING, - DPM/PM FOR CASTING, - PMI FOR ASSEMBLED VALVES IF SS BODY, - HYDROTEST
Painting shall be as per attached Painting Specification
